findings.text: The confirmation statement is overdue; it was next due 13 September 2026 and was last made up to 30 August 2025.
Accounts are not overdue; they were last made up to 31 December 2025 and the next accounts are due 30 September 2027.
Companies House holds no insolvency record for this company.
The company has 10 current officers, including 9 directors, and one person with significant control, HOLDINGS LTD, recorded as holding 75 to 100 percent of shares and voting rights.

Across the 5 current directors checked, 49 other companies were found (36 active, 11 dissolved, 2 liquidation), and the network check flags that directors are linked to two companies in insolvency processes.
The company has 11 satisfied charges registered and no outstanding or part-satisfied charges.
Since 24 October 2025, no registered office address changes were filed, and one director was appointed: PERSON 644 on 9 July 2026.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 689 is an active company incorporated on 6 December 2013 with no insolvency record, but its confirmation statement is overdue.
